knownUnreachable.build:extension:dev: By-hand dev-flag extension bundle. The documented entry point (dev:extension) builds the `custom` variant itself, so this alias exists for inspecting a dev build without the reload loop.
knownUnreachable.test:coverage:history: By-hand coverage trend report over coverage-history.json. No gate reads it: the nightly coverage job uploads coverage/ as its own artifact.
knownUnreachable.e2e:preview: By-hand preview-build E2E suite (playwright.preview.config.ts). It needs a preview server, so neither the chain nor a CI step drives it.
knownUnreachable.e2e:multiuser: By-hand full multi-user suite. The nightly job shards the same config through e2e:multiuser:shard.
knownUnreachable.mock:ai: By-hand OpenAI-compatible mock. The custom-provider topology starts (node scripts/mock-openai-server.mjs) itself from playwright.custom-provider.config.ts.
knownUnreachable.test:human:core: By-hand subset of the human-like example suite (8 specs). The nightly job shards the whole suite through test:human.
knownUnreachable.test:human:depth: By-hand subset of the human-like example suite (7 specs). The nightly job shards the whole suite through test:human.
knownUnreachable.test:human-regression: By-hand single-spec run of the human-like suite (regression-tests.spec.ts). The nightly job shards the whole suite through test:human.
knownUnreachable.test:oculix: By-hand external visual suite: it runs a Maven project from an absolute Windows path (C:\bookmark6-oculix-tests) that is not part of this repository.
knownUnreachable.check:input-contracts: Alias for a validator the chain already runs: check:workflows calls (node scripts/validate-input-contracts.mjs) directly. Kept for running that validator alone.
knownUnreachable.check:bundle-size: Alias for a post-build gate build:ci runs directly (scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs, its bundle-size + report step). Only useful by hand after a build.
knownUnreachable.record:ai-performance-history: By-hand recorder for the AI performance trend (--metrics <file> --history <file>); no workflow and no gate wires it.
knownUnreachable.plan:manual-figures: Development tool: ADR-050 declares the manual-figures planner a by-hand tool, not a gate.
knownUnreachable.check:audit-drift:strict-discovery: By-hand strict-discovery mode of check-audit-drift.mjs. The chain runs the default mode as check:audit-drift.
knownUnreachable.check:audit-drift:fix: By-hand fixer mode of check-audit-drift.mjs (it rewrites anchors and baselines); a gate must never run it.
knownUnreachable.check:coverage-areas: By-hand per-directory coverage budget gate. It needs coverage/lcov.info from test:coverage first, so it cannot live in the offline chain.
knownUnreachable.check:no-unbounded-text:fix: By-hand baseline refresher for check:no-unbounded-text. The chain runs the verify mode, never the fix mode.
